cases.refreshed: Our library volunteer and experienced stamp collector from San Jose Stamp Club invites you to attend a meeting to learn about the fun and educational opportunities with collecting stamps. Meetings are free to attend and held on the 1st Wednesday at 6:45 PM of the month in Pearl Ave Branch Library Community Room. Learn the fun of collecting stamps of a country you love or topic exciting to you. Meetings typically have a presentation targeted to less experienced collectors from an experienced collector. Free and open to everyone. No registration is required. No promotions, donations, fundraising, or sales are allowed. No membership fee is required to attend the meeting.

events.title: Decorate a Henna Candle with Artist Rachel Palacios

cases.refreshed: Come celebrate Diwali, the festival of light over darkness, and create henna designs on an LED candle to take home. For children 3rd grade to 8th grade. No registration required. While supplies last. Space is limited. Generously sponsored by the Friends of Cupertino Library. For accessibility accommodations (ex. ASL), please fill out the online form at sccld.org/accessibility 7+ days prior to the event. If you need assistance with the form, speak with a staff member at your local library, call (408) 540-3945, or email us at ask@sccl.org.
